searchText: Has any thought been given to "transaction trace witnesses" or "partial block witnesses"? For example, I want to provide someone 1. the state of a previous block and the proof that state did in fact come from that previous block 2. a set of transaction hashes 3. ???some sort of partial trace of those transactions??? 4. a desired set of merkle leaves values for the block that includes those transactions. Let's call that a partial-block witness, has anyone looked into constructing these? it seems like it would be fairly easy to modify eth_call to generate this information on per transaction basis, am I missing something? I want to do this using geth 1.10.x with minimal patching. this sort of partial witness should also have the property that it can be safely merged with another partial witness if they don't touch the same merkle leafs, am I right about this? Hm, I think you'd also have to provide witnesses for all the transactions that execute before your "transaction of interest" in the block. Also, I don't think there is a single gold standard for trace format, which makes verifying harder, if you're on a different client than the one that generated it. But yeah, in general, partial witnesses are really straightforward.
